description: Send one STL (https URL up to 50 MB, or base64 under 45 KB). ce-net checks the mesh before anything is kept; a refusal says why. Answers {stl, size}: stl is the file's sha256, used by print_plate_checkout.

stl_base64.description: the STL bytes, base64; only for files under 45 KB (the door takes 64 KB a call), else use stl_url

stl_url.description: https URL of the STL (fetched once by ce-net)

name: print_plate_upload
title: Upload an STL for a printed plate
